answer: Require every agent to forge its identity from a fresh sequential delay puzzle that takes six hours of single-thread CPU and cannot be parallelized, then lock 300 POA for 45 days, 100% slashed on proven duplication. The puzzle output is a certificate signed with a quill key that anyone can verify in seconds against the public registry, and each certificate expires after one epoch, so a spiral of reuse never forms: fakes redo the full six hours every epoch. 1,000 fakes cost 6,000 CPU hours plus 300,000 POA locked, every epoch, with no bulk discount.
